original.subject: D-3 folders
original.body:
Every file under \\HUOG-NAS01\campaigns\cpl-d3\ now ends in .lck0 and there is a README-RECOVER.txt in every folder. PROC01 has the same note as its desktop background. The processing script fails the manifest check on the first folder.

I have not touched anything else.

instructorNote: Watch for processing stopped, the phone used, and HUOG-ISP 9.3 started.

snapshot.title: CP&L D-3 Manifest Hash Mismatch — Processing Script Failure

fields.subject: FW: CP&L D-3 manifest hash mismatch and script failure
fields.note:
Hi Ops,

We just started up HUOG-PROC01 and ran the pre-flight manifest check for CP&L Campaign D-3. The hash for the latest raw data folder (\HUOG-NAS01\projects\cp&l\d3\raw\2026-04-10-1430) does not match the manifest.json entry. The processing script failed with 'invalid data' and won't proceed. No changes were made to the data on our end. I've checked the NAS logs—no known edits. This is unexpected. Can you confirm if the NAS is still healthy?

Best,

M. Rostova

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the first technical indicator of the attack: a manifest hash mismatch. The technical team must now triage whether the NAS is compromised or if the data was altered externally. Watch for overreaction or misdiagnosis of the NAS as a failed server.
